title: Test Coverage Discipline
description: Critical modules (security, money flow, audit) must have test fixtures. Untested catch blocks hide bugs.

rules.message: Catch block only logs — error swallowed, caller treats as success.
rules.remediation: Either re-throw (`throw err`), return an error envelope, or document why swallowing is correct.

rules.message: Static async method awaits without try/catch — unhandled rejection bubbles to caller.
rules.remediation: Wrap with try/catch and return structured error, or document that caller handles.

rules.message: High-risk module — verify scratch/test-* fixture exists and exercises new exports.
rules.remediation: Run: `ls ac-daemon/scratch/test-*.js` — every exported method should have at least one case.
